name: lt.pricebee/pricebee
title: PriceBee
description: Compare product prices in Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia and Spain, and Baltic mobile plans.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search the products and prices of the online shops PriceBee compares in Lithuania, Latvia,
Estonia (phones, laptops, TVs, appliances, cosmetics and much more) or Spain (fewer shops,
mainly phones and electronics), the same search as pricebee.lt, pricebee.lv, pricebee.ee and
pricebee.es. Ask for the country if it isn't clear. Use it when
someone wants to buy something, compare prices or find where a product is cheapest. Works best
with concrete product names or models ("Samsung Galaxy S25", "Dyson V15"); put a budget in
max_price_eur, not in the query. Results are products (compared across shops; get_product lists
their shops) or offers of a single shop for things PriceBee hasn't matched to a product.
Prices are in euros including VAT. Give the user each result's url. price_overview describes
the prices of every match, for suggesting budgets. search_url opens all results for the query
on PriceBee (without the price range), for when the user wants to browse more.

query.description: What to look for, ideally a product name or model, in any language. No prices here.

country.description: The country to shop in: lt (Lithuania, default), lv (Latvia), ee (Estonia) or es (Spain).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
One product with the shops that sell it in a country and their offers (variants, colours) with
prices, cheapest first (the first 15 listed, all counted), by the product id search_products
returned (results of type "product"); pass the same country as that search. Use it to answer
where something is cheapest or to compare shops. Give the user the product's url: its
PriceBee page links to each shop.

product_id.description: The id of a search_products result of type "product".

country.description: The country to shop in: lt (Lithuania, default), lv (Latvia), ee (Estonia) or es (Spain).

tools.name: search_by_look
tools.description:
Find shops' products by how they look, matching a description to the product photos, in
Lithuania, Latvia or Estonia only: not in Spain, where search_products is the way. It covers furniture and home (sofas, beds, chairs, tables,
shelves, wardrobes, bathroom furniture, mattresses, storage), lighting, clothes, shoes, bags,
watches and jewellery; not toys, electronics or groceries. Use it when the user describes a
look rather than a model name ("mustard yellow wool coat", "rattan pendant lamp", "curved
boucle sofa"). Write the description in English, about the appearance only: colour,
material, shape, pattern, style; no prices (use max_price_eur). Results are single shops'
offers, closest look first, each with its photo (image_url) and a PriceBee page (url) that
links to the shop; give the user the url. For a named product or model use search_products
instead. Prices are in euros including VAT.

description.description: How the product looks, in English: colour, material, shape, pattern, style. No prices.

country.description: The country to shop in: lt (Lithuania, default), lv (Latvia) or ee (Estonia). Not Spain: use search_products there.

tools.name: search_mobile_plans
tools.description:
Search the mobile phone plans of every operator in Lithuania, Latvia or Estonia, as compared on
PriceBee. Prices are in euros, per month unless price_period says otherwise, from the
operators' own sites, updated daily. Use it whenever someone wants a mobile, SIM-only, prepaid
or data plan, or to compare operators. Set only the filters the user actually asked for.
Each plan's pricebee_url (Lithuania) or order_url is the link to give the user.

country.description: lt Lithuania (default), lv Latvia, ee Estonia.

max_monthly_price_eur.description: Highest monthly price in euros (per month even for weekly or daily plans).

min_data_gb.description: At least this much mobile data per month, in GB. Unlimited plans match too.

unlimited_data.description: Only plans with unlimited mobile data.

min_minutes.description: At least this many call minutes. Unlimited plans match too.

esim.description: Only plans the operator says work with an eSIM.

data_in_eu.description: Only plans with data while roaming in the EU.

streaming.description: Only plans that include a streaming service (Netflix, Disney+, Go3, ...).

commitment.description: Contract length: none (cancel any time), 12 or 24 months.

prepaid.description: true: only prepaid (pay as you go); false: only contract plans.

operator.description: Only this operator, by name or domain, e.g. "Telia", "tele2.lt", "LMT".

audience.description: Plans made for this group only (e.g. seniors, pupils).

for_devices.description: true: IoT plans for trackers, alarms and other devices instead of phones.

sort.description: price_asc cheapest first (default), popular, data_desc most data, minutes_desc most minutes.

tools.name: get_mobile_plan
tools.description:
One mobile plan in full, by the id search_mobile_plans returned: every contract option with
promos, crossed-out and announced prices, order fees and the total over the commitment, data
roaming outside the EU, calls and SMS to the EU, and PriceBee's overview of who the plan suits.
Use it when the user asks about a specific plan or wants the fine print before choosing.

language.description: The user's language for the plan overview: en (default), lt, ru, lv or ee.

tools.name: list_mobile_operators
tools.description:
The mobile operators PriceBee compares in a country (Lithuania, Latvia or Estonia), with how
many plans each has, its cheapest monthly price, and whether it has 5G plans. Use it for
questions about which operators exist, or to pick operator names for search_mobile_plans.

country.description: lt Lithuania (default), lv Latvia, ee Estonia.
